userStories.title: Implement Liquidity Gatekeeper
userStories.description: System must strictly block any trading ('is_hunting = False') if confirmed Binance USDT balance is below $5. No simulation fallbacks allowed in Production mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Starts in PAUSED mode until balance check passes
Automatically pauses if balance drops below threshold

userStories.title: Fix Binance Signature Error
userStories.description: Render logs show 'Signature for this request is not valid'. This is often due to whitespace in env vars. Solution: Sanitize API keys with .strip() on load.
acceptanceCriteria: API Keys are stripped of whitespace
Binance connection succeeds without Signature Error
